title: Fleet, slot and terminal progress follows worker files without polling
description: Select the existing isolated one-slot fixture with FARMSLOT_OFFLINE_PROOF=1, FARMSLOT_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATION=1, FARMSLOT_HOME, FARMSLOT_ROOT, FARMSLOT_RUNS_DIR, FARMSLOT_SLOT_RESOURCE_PROOF, FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PROFILE, GATEWAY_PORT, VITE_PORT, FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT, FARMSLOT_UI_URL and an absolute FARMSLOT_RUN_WEB_EVIDENCE_DIR. Run against an owned gateway tsx watcher and browser, with the scratch slot initially unoccupied. The driver creates one guarded idle terminal target, seeds its own monitoring run while the gateway is stopped, writes the actual checklist and observes the mounted fleet card, slot task panel and terminal progress tracker through the production gateway. It injects no UI/cache state. Each reader must receive a newer progress revision and send no task.progress reads during eleven idle seconds. Cleanup restores exact slot-status bytes/permissions and removes only the owned run, task directory and scratch session. Error, offline, context and delayed-response acceptance are separate proofs.
